items.information: ###Portuguese **Atenção:** Esta competição terá limite de competitores. Inscreva-se somente se você tem **certeza que irá participar**. Em caso de desistência, por favor **entrar em contato com o delegado (gcampos@worldcubeassociation.org)**. Pagamento da taxa via PIX: mauriciopmfernandes@gmail.com Enviar comprovante para o e-mail: gcampos@worldcubeassociation.org Envie o comprovante com o nome do competidor. **Aviso**: Ao se inscrever para a competição, você automaticamente se disponibiliza para atuar como juiz, runner e/ou embaralhador quando solicitado. A recusa não justificada poderá acarretar em desclaificação (DNF) de um ou mais eventos de acordo com a regra [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2). Para este campeonato, além dos próprios competidores, teremos um pequeno grupo de Staff para ajudar ao longo da competição. Se você tiver interesse em participar, use o formulário abaixo para obter mais informações e poder se inscrever: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1XKt4VJZRzwhAPX9KU7UlqCLxHIoAe6_EUT1a6IVD_1I/edit?pli=1 ###English **Attention:** This competition will have a limit of competitors. Sign up only if you are **sure you will attend**. In case of withdrawal, please **contact the delegate (gcampos@worldcubeassociation.org)**. Payment with PIX method: mauriciopmfernandes@gmail.com Send the payment proof to E-mail: gcampos@worldcubeassociation.org Send the proof with the competitor's name. **Warning:** By registering for the competition, you automatically make yourself available to act as a judge, runner and/or scrambler when requested. Unjustified refusal may result in disqualification (DNF) of one or more events according to rule [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2). For this competition, besides the competitors themselves we will have a small group of dedicated Staff to help throughout the day. If you are interested in this, you can use the form below to get further details and volunteer yourself: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1XKt4VJZRzwhAPX9KU7UlqCLxHIoAe6_EUT1a6IVD_1I/edit?pli=1

items.information: [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) ## Pickering Fall 2023 Series This competition is in a series with [Pickering Fall B 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PickeringFallB2023). You will only be able to compete in ***one*** of these two competitions. ***Attempting to register for both of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted.*** ### Registration Reminders You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted and registration fees will not be transferred across competitions. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. ### Mailing List We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand for competitions in southern Ontario and are regularly planning and announcing more competitions. Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ### Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.
